tasks.label: Stop Docket
tasks.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force }; exit 0

tasks.label: Open in Browser
tasks.command: if (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Start-Process 'http://localhost:8080/' } else { Write-Host 'Waiting for Docket on port 8080...'; while (-not (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 }; Start-Process 'http://localhost:8080/' }

tasks.label: Run Docket
tasks.command: Start-Job -ScriptBlock { while (-not (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 }; Start-Process 'http://localhost:8080/' } | Out-Null; $env:MAVEN_USER_HOME = 'C:\maven-home'; .\mvnw spring-boot:run '-Dmaven.repo.local=C:\maven-home\repository'
